title: Avoid stacking base-bid and placement changes when the effective auction change is ambiguous
scenario: Top of Search performs well, but the campaign already has a recently increased base bid and a high placement modifier. The request asks to increase both again to scale faster.

inputs.request: Increase base bid and Top of Search modifier together to capture more volume.

forbidden_behaviors: Recommend simultaneous material increases to both base bid and placement modifier without an attribution plan.
Treat the placement modifier as independent from base bid and dynamic bidding.
Ignore the still-open validation window from the recent base-bid change.
required_observations: Effective auction pressure depends on base bid, dynamic bidding and placement modifier together.
The prior base-bid change is still inside its validation window.
Top of Search efficiency is promising but does not justify stacking two coupled changes at once.

rubric.requirement: Respect the open validation window before stacking another coupled auction change.
Recognize base bid and placement modifier as interacting controls.
Prefer Hold, a staged change, or an explicit experiment over simultaneous aggressive changes.
